thread:
Priya Kumar: Heads up — primary (Emma) called in sick and our scheduled secondary (Ben) started PTO early for a family emergency. We have the long holiday window tonight (1800-0600 PST) with expected traffic spikes from APAC. I need a volunteer to be primary for the shift or we coordinate a split handoff across timezones. Not an incident yet but want to avoid pages if things spike.

Diego Santos: I can cover the first half (1800-0000 PST) if someone takes 0000-0600. I'm in EU so that lines up ok. I can be primary for mitigation and paging.

Priya Kumar: Thanks Diego. @Alice any chance you can take the late half? You're APAC-adjacent.

Alice Morgan: I can take 0000-0600 PST (my evening). Quick Q: do we expect any model rollouts tonight? I don't see scheduled deploys in the releases channel.

Priya Kumar: No major rollouts. Ops: we have a small A/B traffic ramp for a customer (DeepFinance) that could spike token throughput. Also incident-bot just flagged a small error rate bump on embeddings-serve-02 — looks transient but watch it.

incident-bot: [ALERT] embeddings-serve-02 increased 5xx rate to 1.2% (threshold 0.5%). Recent 10m trend: 0.2% -> 1.2%. Pager policy: page primary after 5m sustained above threshold. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/embeddings#runbook

Ben Walker: I'm on PTO but can be on standby if needed (phone). If Diego takes first half I'm willing to be reachable for escalations.

Emma Li: Sorry everyone — I hate to duck last minute. Thanks for covering. Priya, can you post the minimal checklist we should run if the pager fires? Also who owns the dedicated pool scaling config?

Priya Kumar: Minimal checklist (copied inline):
- Confirm scope: check dashboards for latency/p99 and 5xx. Link: https://dash.redwood/embeddings/serve-02
- Identify if errors are model-serving (OOM/timeout) or infra (disk, NPU failure).
- If infra, run `kubectl get pods -n embeddings -o wide` and look for CrashLoop, OOMKilled.
- If model-serving regression, fallback: switch route to embeddings-serve-01 via routing service (console -> routes -> embeddings -> toggle fallback).
- Scale up: `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/scale -d '{"pool":"embeddings-dedicated","count":2}'` (only after quick check — scaling increases cost).
- Notify customers in #support if impact > 1% requests or > 5 minutes.

Diego Santos: Adding a small snippet to check logs fast:
```
# tail recent logs for errors
kubectl logs -n embeddings -l app=embeddings-serve-02 --since=10m | grep -iE "error|timeout|oom"
```

Oncall-bot: Reminder — escalation chain: primary -> secondary -> SRE lead (Priya) -> oncall manager. Pager routing will attempt primary twice, then secondary.

Alice Morgan: I'll take 0000-0600 PST. Confirmed. I'll enable my phone for pages. Diego, ping me on Signal if anything noisy.

Priya Kumar: Great — assignment: Diego primary 1800-0000 PST, Alice primary 0000-0600 PST. Ben standby (reachable), Emma out. I'll be SRE lead for escalation. Please ack when you see any sustained >0.5% 5xx for 5m.

Ben Walker: ack. If you need me to join bridge, DM.

Diego Santos: ack. I'll set a quick watch script and post status updates every 30m in this thread. Also will pre-scale one additional replica at 1830 if error rate stays >0.3%.

Priya Kumar: Please be conservative on scale — confirm cost approval in thread before scaling beyond +1 replica.

Diego Santos: Understood.

incident-bot: [INFO] embeddings-serve-02 5xx trend returning to baseline 0.4% at 2456789150. No pager triggered. Monitoring continues.

Priya Kumar: Good sign. Diego — when you start your watch script, include a check for KV cache fill rate (we saw a regression last month). KV cache low-hit-rate can cause higher latency and cascade to timeouts.

Diego Santos: Will do. Watch script snippet:
```
# pseudo-check
curl -s https://metrics.redwood/embeddings/serve-02 | jq '.kv_cache.hit_rate'
```

Alice Morgan: If a page lands on me, runbook step 4 (fallback route) is usually the fastest mitigation — keeps customer traffic flowing while we debug. Also: if you switch route, send a brief note to #support-template so they can notify affected customers.

Priya Kumar: Copy. Also leave an audit note in the incident tracker: `inc-tracker/2456789012` if you take action.

Diego Santos: Starting watch now, will ping back at 1915 with first check.

Priya Kumar: Thanks team. If anything degrades to customer impact, create an incident (use /incident create) and assign to me as lead. Otherwise we'll treat this as precautionary.

incident-bot: [INFO] No new incidents. Auto-close window: 24h.

Alice Morgan: I'll be available and have runbooks open. Good luck everyone :coffee:

Priya Kumar: Closing the assignment: Diego -> Alice -> Ben(stby). If anyone's contact info changed, update oncall roster. Signing off from thread for now but keep it alive with status updates.
